{
  "analysis": "Source inspection identifies a likely cause in DexArena.StepShots: collision eligibility checks m.hit.Contains(u), but the collision handler clears m.hit instead of recording the struck unit. The orb remains active after collisions, so successive simulation ticks may damage the same overlapping target. The separate clear at the outward-to-return transition appears intended to permit one additional hit on return. This remains a hypothesis until execution. The scenario compares fine and coarse steps, checks outward and completed-flight damage separately, and includes an off-path enemy control. With AP 0 and target MR 100, one outward hit deals 50 magic damage and one return hit deals 100 true damage.",
